text: dsh-status-bar-config 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的对话统计显示插件。它在对话输入框下方的 dock 区域呈现统计行，并在插件设置中提供显示选项。统计内容包括对话轮数、agent 步骤、模型与工具耗时、首 token 平均时间、生成速度、缓存命中率及输入输出 token；用户可以分别开关各项或恢复默认设置。适合希望在 DSH 对话界面快速查看会话过程和 token 用量的人。代码没有配置 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-status-bar-config adds a configurable statistics row below the DSH Web composer. It shows turns, steps, model and tool time, first-token time, generation speed, cache hits, and token usage. Plugin settings let users toggle measurements or restore defaults.
想在对话输入框下面看到本次会话的轮数和步骤数。
DSH 能不能显示模型耗时、工具耗时和 token 用量？
How can I see token usage and response timing while chatting?
dsh-status-bar-config 的功能「对话统计行」：在对话输入框下方显示轮数、步骤数、模型与工具耗时、首 token 时间、生成速度、缓存命中率和输入输出 token。统计行会按设置隐藏或显示各类指标。
dsh-status-bar-config 的功能「统计显示设置」：在插件设置卡片中开关统计行及每项指标，也可以恢复所有默认值；更改通过设置作用域立即更新显示。

dsh-status-bar-config README · dsh-status-bar-config：English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that makes the conversation statistics row configurable without patching Harness.

It shadows the shipped `conversation.composer.dock` entry with the same `stats` id at a lower public slot priority, preserving the normal placement and visuals while allowing each metric to be hidden independently.

dsh-status-bar-config README · Settings：Open **Settings → Plugins → Conversation statistics**. Changes apply live.

- Entire statistics row
- Turns
- Steps
- LLM time
- Tool-call time
- Average time to first token (TTFT)
- Decode throughput (tokens/second)
- Cache-hit percentage
- Input tokens
- Output tokens

dsh-status-bar-config README · Settings：All metrics are enabled by default and keep the standard order. The row follows the active DSH English or Chinese locale. It uses the durable whole-session projections when available and preserves the shipped loaded-window fallback otherwise.

dsh-status-bar-config README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check
pnpm pack
```

Install the packed tarball through a DSH profile. A newly installed bundle is discovered when that profile next starts; during linked development, host rebuilds hot-reload and client bundle rebuilds require only a page refresh.
